critical.rule: Before creating ANY file, search for existing similar files
critical.check: Run Glob search for similar filenames

critical.rule: Must read a file before editing it
critical.check: Verify file was read in current context

critical.rule: Never make up information - verify or ask
critical.check: Claims must be based on file reads or user input

high.rule: Check SYSTEM_MANIFEST.md before building new features
Frontend changes need backend check, and vice versa
high.check: If HTML changed, verify JS still works

triggers.action: CHECK: Run Glob for similar files first
CHECK: Verify changes tested, CHANGE_LOG updated
CHECK: Confirm with user before destructive action
